top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks provide a distinct, experimentally verified and independently reproducible measurement invention. Katori's original magic-wavelength architecture and Ye's decisive development give the most compact and defensible evidence-to-credit chain, provided the citation remains limited to the demonstrated method rather than a completed time-standard transition.
